title: Unobserved Consideration and Consumer Welfare
abstract: arXiv:2611.07774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can welfare effects of price change be identified when consumers' consideration sets are heterogeneous and unobserved? We establish that the welfare distribution is the same functional of structural choice probabilities under stable but limited consideration as under full consideration. The result permits unrestricted income-effects, preference heterogeneity, and dependence between preferences and consideration. Within this class, limited consideration admits a full-consideration representation preserving choice-probabilities and money-metric compensation: consideration/preferences can remain unidentified while demand and welfare are identified. When consideration sets contract as prices rise, the welfare distribution can be bounded using demand and a bound on choice-set attrition.

translated_title: 不可观测的考虑集与消费者福利
translated_abstract: 当消费者的考虑集是异质的且不可观测时，价格变化的福利效应能否被识别？我们证明，在稳定但有限的考虑集下，福利分布作为结构化选择概率的泛函与完全考虑下的情形相同。该结果允许不受限制的收入效应、偏好异质性，以及偏好与考虑集之间的依赖关系。在这一类模型中，有限考虑集容许一个保持选择概率和货币度量补偿的完全考虑表示：即使考虑集/偏好本身不可识别，需求与福利仍然可以被识别。当考虑集随价格上升而收缩时，可以利用需求以及选择集流失程度的界来对福利分布进行界定。
tldr: 该论文证明在消费者考虑集不可观测但稳定的有限考虑模型中，福利分布与完全考虑模型下完全相同，因此即使考虑集与偏好本身不可识别，需求与消费者福利仍然可以被识别（或在考虑集随价格收缩时可被界定）。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that under stable but unobserved limited consideration, the welfare distribution is the same functional of choice probabilities as under full consideration, so demand and consumer welfare remain identified even when consideration sets and preferences are not.
